$description: Input, Textarea, Select (platform/components/Input), library wave 6, lane B: the filled appearance, the invalid state and the autogrowing text area. The outline appearance and the other states are the shared input tokens.

input-filled-background.$description: Filled field: the neutral fill behind the value (the search field's fill).

input-filled-text.$description: Filled field: the value in dark gray on the gray fill (owner, 2026-10-16); the border is the outline field's.

input-invalid-background.$description: An invalid field: the lightest red fill (owner, 2026-10-16).

input-invalid-inner-width.$description: An invalid field: a line inside its border in the danger color, so the border reads 2px without moving the value (owner, 2026-10-16).

textarea-auto-grow-max-height.$description: Autogrowing text area: the tallest it grows (ten lines, its padding and border); past it, it scrolls inside.

input-warning-border-color.$description: A field with a warning: its border, in the warning content color (readable against the surface; the danger border's sibling). It is kept while focused, like the invalid border.

input-warning-background.$description: A field with a warning: the lightest warning fill.

input-warning-inner-width.$description: A field with a warning: a line inside its border in the warning color, so the border reads 2px without moving the value (as the invalid field's).
